set -eu
source=/module/qore-zmq-module-1.2.0
czmq="$source/czmq-b669c7eb60cb8f587071ac6ece7cd68d30ac4017"
build="$source/build-debug"
for mode in ndebug assertions; do
  if test "$mode" = ndebug; then policy=-DNDEBUG; else policy=-UNDEBUG; fi
  gcc -O2 -g -std=gnu99 -DZMQ_BUILD_DRAFT_API=1 -DCZMQ_BUILD_DRAFT_API=1 -DCZMQ_STATIC -DZMQ_STATIC -D_GNU_SOURCE "$policy" -I"$czmq/src" -I"$czmq/include" -I"$build/_deps/czmq-build" -I"$source/libzmq-4.3.5/include" -I"$build/_deps/libzmq-build" -c control.c -o "$mode.o"
  g++ "$mode.o" "$build/_deps/czmq-build/libczmq.a" "$build/_deps/libzmq-build/lib/libzmq.a" -lsodium -lgnutls -llz4 -luuid -lbsd -pthread -o "$mode"
done
set +e
./ndebug > negative.log 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
test "$status" = 7
./assertions
valgrind --error-exitcode=99 --leak-check=full --errors-for-leak-kinds=all --log-file=valgrind.log ./assertions
